summary.intent: Win the Lio 'Keep the Line Running' hackathon challenge for Soony by building a general, adaptable agent product that polls the portal, finds launch risks hidden in messy data, and acts on them (supplier emails, approvals), plus prepare the demo, docs and hand-in.
summary.outcome: Analysed the Soony data and found the Collector's Edition and Standard shortfalls. Built a polling, versioned-store, agent-driven app (Today and Launch views, approval loop with phone /ok page, routines, dry-run demo instance, README, demo script). Pushed through `3468eb8` on `jonas/today-flow`; the demo script, calls switch, calmer-numbers and ⌘↵ shortcut commits are still local. Rehearsal, video and pitch are not done.

repo: The portal API has only three endpoints (files list, single file, archive.zip) and no webhooks. The spec says to poll the file list and compare SHA-256 checksums, because existing files are replaced under the same name.
Confidential portal data lives in the gitignored `data/` folder, and `.env` is gitignored while `.env.example` is committed. Nothing from the data may be copied into code or the repo.
The repo has a team workflow in `CLAUDE.md` and `PROGRESS.md`; claim tasks in `PROGRESS.md`.
Entire only writes a checkpoint when repo files changed, so early read-only turns show 'no files modified, skipping checkpoint'. Checkpoints are pushed along with `git push`.

A shared mailbox sync wrote back a stale copy of the action log and lost records made in the meantime. This lost the 07:58 art book approval record. It is fixed by appending under the shared lock (`dd71984`) with a test.

Prepared proposals went stale when their case was decided by hand, so 'Do all 4' failed with 'not an open card'. They now expire automatically, are deduplicated across routines, and are shown one row per routine (`7cab80b`).

Demo instance: `scripts/demo.sh reset|snapshot|stop` at `ask-soony-demo.stenglein.dev`. It has all cases open, supplier emails recorded to a dry outbox, and sync, Teams and polling off. Calls are dry_run unless started with `CALLS=twilio`.
The web UI polls state every 5 s (`POLL_MS = 5000`) and routine data every 15 s; there is no server push.
Phone calls use `ASK_CALL_PROVIDER=dry_run` in `.env` and cost about $0.38/min on Twilio when enabled.

The approval loop (`signoff.py`, `OkPage.tsx`) sends a one-time `/ok/<token>` link by push. Push goes to every subscribed device, with no per-person routing. `ASK_SIGNOFF_SIMULATE=<seconds>` auto-approves for demos and labels it simulated.
J/K navigation must step per list row, not per case, because folded groups ('5 like this') contain several cases (`76aa704`).
Server code changes need a restart of live and demo; the front end is served fresh from `web/dist` after `npm run build`.
workflow: Delegating long builds to subagents (cross-check of 200 order confirmations and 59 scans, the sign-off loop) while working on other things in parallel was effective. Their uncommitted work needed review, commit and a server restart afterwards.
Verifying UI changes in the browser (screenshots, pressing J ten times and checking the highlighted row) caught issues that tests missed.
Check for doc edits before updating shared Claude Docs, and ask before outward-facing actions such as pushing, sending supplier emails or switching on paid calls.
A Cloudflare 1033 error appeared during the DNS propagation window after the demo hostname was initially routed to the wrong tunnel.

Hooks seemed not to fire, but the checkpoint was skipped because no repo files had changed.

Some UI wording was awkward (the 'Your agents are on it' sentence, 'Decide by' on cases held by Maren).
